info.title: HE Engine API
info.description: A self-hosted engine for computing on encrypted data. Clients keep their TFHE client key; the server evaluates on ciphertexts with the server key they upload. Every error is `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.

200.description: Sent if the account exists (the answer is the same either way)

302.description: Redirect to the frontend page, token in the fragment. Consumes nothing.
Redirect to GitHub, with a state cookie

get.summary: Where GitHub returns the user after sign-in.

302.description: Redirect to the frontend with `#code=` (exchange it at `/auth/exchange`) or `#error=`
Redirect to Google, with a state cookie

302.description: Redirect to the frontend with `#code=` (exchange it at `/auth/exchange`) or `#error=`

401.description: Wrong email or password, or the email is not verified

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` — ends this browser's session (its whole family).

200.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/auth/providers` — which sign-in buttons the frontend should show.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` — exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access
token and a new refresh cookie.

200.description: A new access token; the refresh cookie is rotated

401.description: No valid session (the cookie is cleared)

202.description: Verification email sent. The same answer is given when the address already has an account.

200.description: Sent if an unverified account exists (the answer is the same either way)

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password` — sets a new password (once per link) and
signs out every session.

200.description: Password set; every session is signed out

400.description: Invalid or expired link, or weak password

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/auth/verify?token=` — links in emails sent before verification
moved to the frontend. Redirects without consuming the token.

302.description: Redirect to the frontend page, token in the fragment. Consumes nothing.

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/verify` — confirms the email address and signs the user in.

post.description:
Honours an `Idempotency-Key` header: resending the same request with the same
key returns the original job (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of
queuing and charging a second one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-255 visible ASCII characters. A retry with the same key and body returns the original job instead of queuing (and charging) another.

202.description: Queued (or, for a replayed idempotency key, the original job)

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this is the original job of a reused key

400.description: Wrong number or shape of inputs, bad base64, a malformed proven list, a scalar out of range, an invalid program, or a bad Idempotency-Key

422.description: Unknown operation or type; proven inputs for a key without proof support or public key; or the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request

429.description: Daily quota used up, or too many jobs waiting; see `Retry-After`

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/compute/jobs/batch` — queue several jobs at once, all or none.
post.description:
With an `Idempotency-Key`, job *i* is keyed `<key>/<i>`: resending the batch
returns the original jobs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-255 visible ASCII characters, for the whole batch. A retry with the same key and body returns the original jobs.

202.description: Every job queued (or, for a replayed idempotency key, the original jobs), in request order

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when these are the original jobs of a reused key

400.description: An empty or oversized batch, or any job that would be refused on its own (the message names it)

404.description: A job names no server key of yours

413.description: Body too large: all inputs together are limited like one job's

429.description: Not enough daily quota or active-job room for every job; nothing is queued

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/compute/jobs/{id}` — removes a job that is not running, with
its stored ciphertexts.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/compute/jobs/{id}/result` — an encrypted result as
`application/octet-stream`: a `safe_serialize`d ciphertext of the type in
`result_types[output]` (`FheBool` for comparisons), or, for a job with
`compressed_results`, one `CompressedCiphertextList` of every result.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description:
Which result (0-based; default 0), for a program with several outputs.
A compressed job has one list holding them all: output 0.

200.description: The encrypted result: a `safe_serialize`d ciphertext of the type `result_types[output]` names (e.g. `FheUint16`, or `FheBool` for comparisons), or a `CompressedCiphertextList` of every result if the job has `compressed_results`

404.description: No such job, or no such output

get.summary: The CRS proven inputs are made against, as `application/octet-stream`.

200.description: A `safe_serialize`d (compressed) TFHE-rs `CompactPkeCrs`; its SHA-256 is `proofs.crs_sha256` of `/he/params`

get.summary: What a client needs to produce compatible keys and inputs.
Liveness: the process is up and answering.

Readiness: the database answers, both stores accept new files and every
job worker is running. Only `200` means the instance should get traffic.

requestBody.description: A `safe_serialize`d TFHE-rs `CompressedServerKey` for the parameters of `/he/params`

400.description: Not a compressed server key for these parameters

409.description: The account already has its maximum number of keys

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/keys/{id}` — removes the key; its jobs stay but lose the reference.

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/keys/{id}/public-key` — body is a `safe_serialize`d TFHE
`CompactPublicKey` made from the same client key as server key `id`.

200.description: Stored; proven inputs can now be sent for this key

400.description: Not a compact public key for these parameters

422.description: The server key was made without proof support

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/user/account` — deletes the account and everything it owns.

200.description: The account, its keys and jobs are deleted

403.description: Wrong password, or (without a password) no sign-in in the last 5 minutes

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/user/me` — the signed-in user, their sign-in methods and today's usage.

put.summary: `PUT /api/v1/user/password` — changes the password and signs out every session.

200.description: Changed; every session is signed out

400.description: Weak password, or the account has no password

oneOf.description: The job's encrypted input with this index (0-based).

input.description: The job's encrypted input with this index (0-based).

oneOf.description: The result of an earlier step (0-based).

step.description: The result of an earlier step (0-based).

oneOf.description: A plaintext constant in decimal, e.g. `"-3"`. The server sees it.

const.description: A plaintext constant in decimal, e.g. `"-3"`. The server sees it.

AuthResponse.description:
A signed-in session. The refresh token is not here: it is set as the
`HttpOnly` cookie `heaas_refresh` (path `/api/v1/auth`).

BatchJobsRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/compute/jobs/batch`: several jobs, queued together or not at all.

BatchJobsResponse.description: The queued jobs of a batch, in request order.

Checks.description: Each check: `"ok"`, or why it failed.

job_store.description: Files can be created in the job store.

key_store.description: Files can be created in the key store.

workers.description: Running job workers out of those started, e.g. `2/2`.

CreateJobRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/compute/jobs`: compute `operation` on encrypted inputs.

The inputs are either `inputs` (one ciphertext each) or `proven_inputs` (one
zero-knowledge-proven list holding all of them), never both. Binary operations
take two inputs, or one input and a `scalar`; `sum` takes 2 to `max_inputs`.

compress_results.description:
Return the results as one TFHE-rs `CompressedCiphertextList` (~2 KB)
instead of one ciphertext each. Needs a key that `supports_compression`.

inputs.description:
Standard base64 of `safe_serialize`d ciphertexts of `integer_type` (e.g.
`FheUint16`), encrypted with the client key that belongs to `key_id`.

key_id.description: One of the caller's registered server keys.

oneOf.description: The steps to run, for `operation: "program"` (and only then).

proven_inputs.description:
Standard base64 of one `safe_serialize`d `ProvenCompactCiphertextList`
encrypted under the key's public key, proven against the server's CRS with
metadata `he-engine/proof/v1/<key_id>`.

scalar.description: A plaintext right-hand operand in decimal, e.g. `"-7"`. The server sees it.

code.description:
Stable, machine-readable reason; one of [`error_codes`]. New codes may be
added, so clients should fall back on the HTTP status for unknown ones.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show to the user.

HeParams.description: `GET /api/v1/he/params`: what a client needs to make compatible keys and inputs.

integer_type.description: The TFHE-rs type of the default `integer_type` (`u16`).

integer_types.description: Every type a job can compute on (absent before HE Engine 0.5: `u16` only).

max_batch_jobs.description:
Most jobs in one batch (`POST /api/v1/compute/jobs/batch`); a batch's
inputs together are limited like one job's.

max_inputs.description: Most encrypted inputs one job takes (a `sum`).

max_job_input_bytes.description: Most input bytes one job takes, all inputs together.

max_table_entries.description: Most entries in one lookup table.

oneOf.description: Absent on servers before HE Engine 0.5, which take no proven inputs.

tfhe_version.description: Clients must use exactly this TFHE-rs release.

IntegerType.description:
The encrypted integer types jobs can compute on. Arithmetic wraps modulo
2^bits; signed types use two's complement.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; `None` on the last page.

JobSummary.description: A job as its owner sees it: metadata only, never ciphertexts.

attempts.description: Attempts started so far (internal errors are retried).

compressed_results.description: The results are one compressed list (`GET …/result` returns it whole).

error_message.description: Why the job failed, if it did.

input_bytes.description: Total size of the submitted ciphertexts.

key_id.description: The server key the job is evaluated with; `None` once that key is deleted.

proven.description: The inputs were a zero-knowledge-proven list.

result_bytes.description:
Size of the encrypted results together
(`GET /api/v1/compute/jobs/{id}/result?output=N`).

result_type.description: The type to decrypt the (first) result as: `bool` for comparisons.

result_types.description:
The type of every result, in order: one for operations, one per output
for programs. Empty from servers before HE Engine 0.6 (read `result_type`).

scalar.description: The plaintext right-hand operand, if the job has one.

MessageResponse.description: A plain confirmation, e.g. after registration.

NotReady.description: The error envelope, plus what failed.

Operation.description:
Homomorphic operations. Arithmetic wraps modulo 2^bits of the input type;
comparisons return an encrypted boolean.

Every operation except [`Sum`](Operation::Sum) and
[`Program`](Operation::Program) takes two operands: two ciphertexts, or one
ciphertext and a plaintext `scalar` as the right-hand side. `Sum` adds 2 to
[`MAX_INPUTS`] ciphertexts. `Program` runs the job's
[`Program`](crate::program::Program) on 1 to [`MAX_INPUTS`] ciphertexts.

outputs.description:
The steps (0-based) whose values are the job's results, in order: 1 to
`max_program_outputs` of them. Absent: the last step alone.

ProgramOp.description: What a step computes. Arithmetic wraps modulo 2^bits of the program's type.

crs_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the CRS served at `GET /api/v1/he/crs`.

max_bits.description: Most plaintext bits one proven list may hold.

metadata_prefix.description: Proofs are made with metadata `<metadata_prefix><key id>`.

has_public_key.description:
The matching compact public key has been uploaded
(`PUT /api/v1/keys/{id}/public-key`).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the uploaded bytes.

supports_compression.description:
The key holds compression keys (it was made with the SDK's compressing
configuration), so jobs can ask for `compress_results`.

supports_proofs.description:
The key was made with the compact-public-key parameters, so it can take
proven inputs once its public key is uploaded. Keys from before HE Engine
0.5 cannot.

table.description:
For `lookup` only: 1 to `max_table_entries` entries with distinct keys.
The server sees the table.

TableEntry.description: One entry of a lookup table: `key` maps to `value` (decimal constants).

ValueType.description: The type of a job's encrypted result: the input type, or `bool` for comparisons.

CrossOrigin.description: A browser request from an origin that is not allowed

Error.description: Any other error, in the error envelope

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client or for this account

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

bearer.description: The access token from sign-in or `/auth/refresh` (15 minutes by default)

refresh_cookie.name: heaas_refresh
refresh_cookie.description: `HttpOnly` cookie set at sign-in; only sent to `/api/v1/auth`

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Accounts and sessions. Browser calls must come from an allowed `Origin`.
